create_curvature_estimator: create a CurvatureEstimator with a tagged function, func args, L2 regularization, and estimation mode
multiply_inverse_blocks: multiply a parameter vector by the damped inverse of curvature blocks using multiply_inverse
multiply_blocks: multiply a parameter vector by the damped curvature blocks using multiply
update_curvature_estimate: update the curvature matrix estimate using EMA smoothing over a batch with a given estimation mode
update_curvature_inverse: update the curvature inverse estimate for all blocks using the diagonal weight and pmap axis name
